high_level_description: The image depicts a scene in what appears to be a fashion design or tailoring workshop. The setting is well-lit with a modern, clean aesthetic, featuring white walls and a large window allowing natural light to enter. In the foreground, there is a mannequin torso dressed in a beige jacket with a distinctive sleeve design. The jacket has a classic button-up front and a tailored fit. The sleeve is being adjusted by a person who is standing beside the mannequin. This individual is wearing a black blazer, blue jeans, and a watch on their left wrist.
